# Inquiries Journal

> A peer-reviewed, open-access multidisciplinary academic journal publishing original research and scholarship from undergraduate and graduate students across social sciences, humanities, and arts.

Inquiries Journal is a student-led publication that provides a platform for emerging scholars to publish peer-reviewed work spanning fields from political science and economics to literature and gender studies. The journal maintains rolling submissions and archives of published articles organized by academic discipline.

## About & Getting Started

- [Inquiries Journal - Online Academic Student Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com): Multidisciplinary student journal for social sciences, arts, humanities scholarship
- [About Inquiries Journal - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/about-inquiries-journal): History and development of Inquiries Journal, formerly Student Pulse
- [Submit to Inquiries Journal - Inquiries Journal](https://www.inquiriesjournal.com/submissions): Submission guidelines and rolling submission form for academic work

## Browse & Archives

- [Current Issue - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/current-issue): Browse current and archived issues of Inquiries Journal
- [Inquiries Journal Blog - A Forum for College and Grad Students](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/blog): Official blog with journal updates, announcements, and academic commentary

## Social Sciences & Policy Research

- [Political Science Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/44/political-science): Free peer-reviewed political science research articles and scholarship
- [Economics Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/18/economics): Economics research on inequality, labor, agriculture, and political economy
- [International Affairs Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/30/international-affairs): International affairs research covering global conflicts and humanitarian issues
- [Criminology & Criminal Justice Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/16/criminology-and-criminal-justice): Criminal justice research on policy, drug trafficking, and prison systems
- [Business & Communications Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/13/business-and-communications): Business and communications research on media, technology, and workplace

## Psychology, Sociology & Anthropology

- [Psychology Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/45/psychology): Peer-reviewed psychology research on cognitive, behavioral, and mental health
- [Sociology Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/47/sociology): Sociology research on criminal justice, gender, identity, and culture
- [Anthropology Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/17/anthropology): Anthropology scholarship on ethnography, gender, culture, and indigenous studies

## Identity & Cultural Studies

- [Women's & Gender Studies Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/56/womens-and-gender-studies): Gender studies research on feminist activism, LGBTQ rights, and identity
- [African-American Studies Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/1/african-american-studies): African-American studies scholarship on history, identity, and culture

## Humanities & Language Studies

- [Literature Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/52/literature): Literary analysis and humanities scholarship on fiction and poetry
- [History Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/26/history): Historical scholarship spanning world history, military history, and empires
- [Philosophy Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/42/philosophy): Philosophy scholarship on ethics, political philosophy, and social classification
- [Linguistics Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/34/linguistics): Linguistics research on American Sign Language and sociolinguistics

## Education

- [Education Articles - Inquiries Journal](http://www.inquiriesjournal.com/topics/50/education): Education research on higher education, ESL, and school systems
